title: Normal integral Noetherian system for a supplied absolute approximation
statement: Let $S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated integral scheme with integrally closed stalks [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], and let $N$ be a Noetherian approximation of $S$ [def-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system]. There exist a small cofiltered category $I$, a diagram $X:I\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ and a limiting cone $\alpha:S\to X$. Every $X_i$ is integral, Noetherian, quasi-separated and has integrally closed stalks. Every transition map of $X$ is affine and every projection $\alpha_i$ is dominant.

proof.text: For each stage of the supplied approximation N, form the integral scheme-theoretic image of S and normalize it in its own function field. Its affine chart rings are finite type integer domains. Their integral closures are finite by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-z-domain-normalization-finite], so the normalizations are Noetherian integral schemes with integrally closed stalks. Normality of S supplies dominant factorization maps to these stages.

The universal property of normalization gives unique transition maps compatible with N and the projections from S, hence their functor and cone identities. A transition followed by the finite normalization map is affine; the finite map is separated, and affineness of the composite implies affineness of the transition. The stages are Noetherian and therefore quasi-separated.

On the inverse images of affine charts at an original stage, the image rings and their normalizations embed in the corresponding normal ring of S. The new rings contain the original image rings whose filtered colimit is that ring of S; thus they have the same colimit. The affine spectrum limit calculation identifies the limit on these charts with S. The identifications agree on overlaps, so they glue to the asserted limit cone.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normal_noetherian_refinement {S : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (N : S.NoetherianApproximation) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (hcat : SmallCategory I),
      letI : SmallCategory I := hcat
      ∃ (hco : IsCofiltered I) (X : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
        (α : (Functor.const I).obj S ⟶ X) (hα : IsLimit (Cone.mk S α))
        (hI : ∀ i, IsIntegral (X.obj i)),
        (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (X.map f)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsDominant (α.app i)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsNoetherian (X.obj i) ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (X.obj i) ∧
          ∀ x : X.obj i, IsIntegrallyClosed ((X.obj i).presheaf.stalk x))
